name: buckley-medium-11
original:
add(review): add evidence and ledger sections to review depth prompts

- Require BALANCED and IN-DEPTH review prompts to include literal `## Evidence Collected` and `## Verification Ledger` headings so reviews carry observed evidence and tested hypotheses.
- Apply the sections to branch, project, and PR review prompts and their approval critics, while leaving spot reviews unchanged.
- Extend policy and prompt tests to assert the headings reach primary and critic prompts.
